items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: She said a fellow by the name of, she didn't say, yeah, she said P-Nots, not P-Nots, P-Nots. He played the flute with this string band.

ctx.x: They were fakers then, but they didn't use a clarinet. She said a fellow by the name of, she didn't say, yeah, she said P-Nots, not P-Nots, P-Nots. He played the flute with this string band. They had a bass and a violin, a mandolin, two guitars, and a flute.
Do you suppose it was anything like jazz?
